summary: Frontend-only verification of the OperationalVigilance admin redesign (3-tier grouped header + single-eye action + centered VigilanceDetailModal + per-submission accordion). Executed via Playwright against the preview URL as admin/HrAdmin@2109. All redesign requirements verified end-to-end. One environmental blocker: vigilance employee logins (madhan.s / dinesh.t with Vigil@123) both return 'Invalid credentials' so the own-view (/employee/vigilance) UI could not be actively exercised this iteration. Credentials file itself flags these accounts as 'drifts frequently' — this is NOT a regression of the current change (own view code was not touched).
